title: roadmap-node/1
description: The YAML front matter of one roadmap node, roadmap/nodes/<id>.md (CONVENTIONS sections 2 and 3; docs/briefs/architecture/roadmap-brief1.md). Authored. This schema checks the shape of one node only; structure across nodes (one root, a tree, blocking edges, leaf versus interior versus stub) is checked by tools/roadmap. Status is derived and never stored here. `done_when` is the node's completion criterion (a 'gate' in this repo is a blocking check, so the word is not used here); it is required on leaves and forbidden on interior nodes and stubs, which the library enforces. Paths are relative to the repo root and may not leave it.

title.description: A verifiable end state, not an area.

blocked_by.description: Nodes this node waits for; may cross branches.

stub.description: A childless placeholder that has not been decomposed. Carries neither done_when nor estimate_days.

signed_off.description: Meaningful only with done_when.type manual. Only Joe sets it.

superseded_by.description: Marks a retired node; IDs are never deleted.

rel_path.description: Repo-relative, forward slashes, no parent-directory segment.
